resources.string: Use this phone as a parent
This app will discard its signing key. Rules and issued approvals stay unchanged. Delete this phone in the router to revoke its old approval key.
Approve requests only for children assigned to this phone in the router. Device Owner is not required. LAN delivery works while the router is reachable; off-home notifications are not available yet.
Approve this fingerprint in the router, then assign the children this phone may approve for.
Ask for extra minutes for this phone. A parent can approve fewer; unused minutes expire two hours after approval. Standing rules stay unchanged.
Your extra time has its own limit. Other apps and rules may still be paused.
This phone has not confirmed the extra time yet. Refresh to check.
Extra time cannot be verified right now. Check usage access and refresh after a restart.
New requests appear here when your assigned children ask for extra time. Refresh to check the router.
Choose which children this phone may approve for in the router’s Phones page. Parent access never grants router administration.
Extra time cannot bypass an active pact.
The router may already have received it. Retry sends exactly the same signed action, not another request or another allocation.
This only discards the local retry. It does not cancel a request or reverse an approval already received by the router.
The action could not be verified. Check the connection; a saved action can be retried safely.
The router could not accept this action. Refresh to check scope, expiry and current request status.
Approved. Extra time becomes usable when the child phone applies the policy.
Only a fresh router response can confirm an approval. Offline or stale screens never grant access.
